newsitem.title: USA: FoxMeyer Health to omit preferred dividend.
newsitem.headline: FoxMeyer Health to omit preferred dividend.

text.p: FoxMeyer Health Corp said on Friday that it has determined not to make the next quarterly cash dividend payments that are scheduled for January 1997 for two series of preferred stock.
The company said it will not pay dividends on either the company's $5.00 cumulative convertible preferred stock or its $4.20 cumulative exchangeable series A preferred stock.

FoxMeyer also said it has complied with its sinking fund obligations for the $5.00 cumulative convertible preferred shares and will not be required to redeem any further shares of that stock on January 15, 1997.
